passages.title: Orrin Library
passages.text: The Orrin Library is a public library in the city of Velmora. It was founded by Dalia Moss in 1902. The library holds 2.4 million volumes and is open every day except Sunday.

verdicts.rationale: p1 gives the founding year as 1902.
